footer.motto: “Time does not erase the words written to meet you in the future.”
footer.colophon: Held under private postal custody. Encrypted at rest until scheduled release.
footer.rights: All rights reserved. Personal Archival Vault.

landing.headline: Write today to the person you will become.
landing.subheadline: TimeEcho is a private postal vault where your letters travel through time, sealed with 3D crimson wax and safeguarded until the date of your choosing.
landing.quote: “We do not write to remember the past, but to bear witness to what we promised to become.”

preview.hint: Click the crimson wax seal to fracture the demonstration seal.
preview.brokenHint: Seal fractured! The parchment is now unsealed.

features.materialityDesc: Parchment paper textures, Manila folders with cut tabs, cancellation postmarks, and tactile 3D wax seals.
features.custodyDesc: Immune to premature opening. Your words remain encrypted until the clock strikes the appointed second.
features.retrospectionDesc: Compare past milestone predictions against present reality and calibrate your psychological emotional shift.

dashboard.title: Correspondence Vault
dashboard.description: Explore your safeguarded letters, active countdowns in transit, and unsealed dockets.
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, content, or docket (e.g., TE-00421)...

emptyState.title: No letters match this filter
emptyState.description: No archival dockets were found matching the selected criteria.

composer.title: Write a Letter to the Future
composer.subtitle: Pen your honest thoughts. Your letter will be sealed with crimson wax until the appointed arrival day.
composer.titlePlaceholder: e.g., Reflections on Crossing the Threshold
composer.letterPlaceholder:
Dear future self:

Today I take the pen to write to you because...
composer.emotionalSectionSubtitle: How do you feel in this exact moment of writing? (Scale 1 to 10)
composer.predictionsSectionSubtitle: State concrete predictions to contrast when you break the seal in the future.

success.title: Capsule Sealed Successfully
success.description: Your letter is now encrypted and secured under postal custody. The crimson seal will preserve your reflections until the appointed day.

reveal.lockedDesc: This correspondence is safeguarded and sealed under archival custody. The crimson seal protects reflections and predictions until the time voyage concludes.
reveal.sealLockedSubtext: Immune to premature opening until the scheduled release date.
reveal.unlockableDesc: The journey through time has concluded. The sealed parchment rests before you, ready for the crimson wax to be broken.
reveal.breakSealPrompt: Click to break the wax seal!
reveal.realityLedgerPromptTitle: How accurate was your past self?
reveal.realityLedgerPromptDesc: Submit your Reality Ledger to contrast past predictions with present facts, record emotional shifts, and compute your accuracy score.

reality.title: Reality Ledger
reality.subtitle: Confrontation between expectations and destiny.
reality.introDesc: Examine your past self’s convictions against the present reality. Record your current emotional baseline and evaluate whether your predictions were fulfilled, unfulfilled, or diverged.
reality.successDesc: Your retrospective notes and emotional ratings have been preserved in the vault.
reality.evolutionSubtitle: Calibrate your feelings at this moment of unsealing:

analytics.title: Retrospective Analytics Vault
analytics.description: Aggregate analysis of your future visions, prediction accuracy calibration, and emotional trajectory across epistolary time.
analytics.emotionalTrajectoryDesc: Aggregate comparison between your emotional ratings at the moment of composition (Baseline) and upon breaking the seal in the present (Reveal).
analytics.pendingAuditsDesc: You have unsealed letters with pending predictions. Settle their reality to automatically update your global statistics.
analytics.allAudited: All unsealed letters have completed their reality evaluation.
